info.x-resource-name: Requisition Line Item Payment Application Associations

parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.summary: List Requisition Line Item Payment Application Associations
get.description:
Returns the owner Payment Applications that each line item of a requisition (subcontractor
invoice) was prefilled into.

Prefill v2 associations are line-item-exact: `line_item_id` is the requisition line item
(Billings Progress) id. Legacy (prefill_version != 2) associations are only known at the
requisition level and are returned with a `null` `line_item_id`, one row per associated
Payment Application.

Access mirrors the requisition line items permission: a user without commitment view receives
a 403. Payment Applications the user cannot view (prime contract permission) are omitted, so a
user with commitment view but no prime contract access receives an empty array.

parameters.name: line_item_ids
parameters.description: Optional list of requisition line item (Billings Progress) ids to filter the associations by.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

schema.description: Requisition line item to owner Payment Application associations

data.description: One entry per (line item, payment application) association.

line_item_id.description:
The requisition line item (Billings Progress) id the Payment Application was prefilled from.
Populated for prefill v2 associations (line-item-exact) and `null` for legacy
(prefill_version != 2) associations, which are only known at the requisition level.

item_type.description:
The requisition item type the line item belongs to (the SOV / change-order item). `null`
for legacy associations.

item_id.description:
The requisition item id (of `item_type`) the line item belongs to. `null` for legacy
associations. Together with `item_type` this correlates to the line items endpoint's
`requisition_item_id` / `requisition_item_type`.

payment_application.description: The owner Payment Application the line item was prefilled into.

number.description: The Payment Application number (its sequential position within the contract).

url.description: Deep-link URL to the Payment Application.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/invoices/requisitions/123/line_item_payment_application_associations?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&line_item_ids=6&line_item_ids=7")

data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Add the Requisition Line Item Payment Application Associations endpoint
x-changelog.description:
New BETA endpoint returning the owner Payment Applications that each line item of a
requisition (subcontractor invoice) was prefilled into. v2 prefill associations are
line-item-exact (line_item_id, item_type, item_id); legacy associations are
requisition-level with null line_item_id/item fields.
